ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: once he led his fellow gods to victory against the titans, and so intends again.

ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: the heavens themselves could split asunder if he so willed.

ZeusUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the patriarch of mount olympus did not rise to his station by mere happenstance.

HeraUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: the goddess of unions knows even the strongest bonds can break.

HeraUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: she alone has the capacity to keep the other gods in check.

HeraUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: her powers over the intangible are never to be underestimated.

PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: the vast seas roil when he wills it thus, and the mountains tremble.

PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: the surface of the world in its entirety is his domain by fate.

PoseidonUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the raw might of a crashing wave; a simple manifesting of his awesome strength.

ApolloUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: brilliance without measure, talent without equal.

ApolloUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: he has yet to find a skill at which he does not excel.

ApolloUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: music and poetry would both be void of life if not for him.

AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: she instills in mortalkind the longing that inspires them and spurs them to action.

AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: her power is such that, even in the realm of the dead, a certain beauty thrives.

AphroditeUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: mortals can perhaps survive without her power; but without it, cannot truly live.

DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: she controls the very cycle of life and death; of abundance and decay.

DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: with the turning of the seasons can come hope and renewal, or desolation beyond words.

DemeterUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the mistress of seasons holds sway over everything between heaven and earth.

HestiaUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: from the comfort of the hearth, to the rage of an inferno.

HestiaUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: the eldest, most reclusive olympian has fire in her heart.

HestiaUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: her flames bring quaint comfort, or ruinous destruction.

HestiaUpgrade_SacrificeBoon_FlavorText.name: make your sacrifice to the goddess of the hearth.

HephaestusUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: the forge-god's volcanic furnace births the world's finest arms.

HephaestusUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: the strongest metal still bends effortlessly to his will.

HephaestusUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the incomparable arms and armor that he fashions are prized even by gods.

HermesUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: the family messenger is often tasked with spreading vital news, or keeping vital secrets.

HermesUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: none can travel as swiftly from the peaks of olympus to the depths of the underworld.

HermesUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the herald of the gods is never one to sit idly by when opportunity awaits.

ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: the lone huntress moves in moonlight to the rhythms of the earth.

ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: she moves through the woods like a flash of silver, lethal to her prey.

ArtemisUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the hunt means knowing when to be utterly still, and knowing when to strike.

DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: mirth is needed more than ever in the darkest of times.

DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: the greatest joys cannot be contained and are to be shared.

DionysusUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: moments spent in good company and cheer are to be savored.

AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: however fraught the path to victory may be, she always finds the way.

AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: with wisdom, many challenges may be overcome; and many more, avoided.

AthenaUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: she who bears the aegis is protector of the heavens and the righteous.

AresUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: he stokes his violent conflicts so that mortalkind can never multiply too quickly.

AresUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: violence is a force of nature in and of itself, and not merely a consequence.

AresUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the impulse to harm and eliminate can be as powerful as the impulse to nurture and create.

HadesUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: his is an infernal strength flowing from darkest depths.

HadesUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: the living and the dead yet fear his very name.

HadesUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: his surpassing might once overwhelmed the titans.

SpellDrop_FlavorText01.name: she in her silver chariot conceals ferocious power known to few.

SpellDrop_FlavorText02.name: the eye of night watches silently, taking stock of all that transpires.

SpellDrop_FlavorText03.name: her distant silver light is a guiding beacon to all those who move in shadow.

TrialUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: all once sprang from the infinite void, even time itself.

TrialUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: from an unfathomable abyss emerged creation and life, gods and mortals.

TrialUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the darkness from which all existence emerged yet remains.

WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: the ever-reclusive artisan lets his masterwork do the talking.

WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: no mere weaponsmith can hone the nocturnal arms; only one of talent to surpass the gods.

WeaponUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: his surpassing skill as craftsman and inventor was well-recognized even in death.

StackUpgrade_FlavorText01.name: its each and every seed, like a drop of blood; life as well as death.

StackUpgrade_FlavorText02.name: whether they sprang from the surface or from underworld, who now can say?

StackUpgrade_FlavorText03.name: the power of the warmth of spring; the strength of dark of the earth.

TalentDrop_FlavorText01.name: one's possibilities for growth are as innumerable as the stars.

TalentDrop_FlavorText02.name: the constant stars above, eternal in their multitude and possibility.

TalentDrop_FlavorText03.name: even the moon must find her way across the sky by certain means.

NarcissusGiftsMenu_FlavorText01.name: would-be suitors lavished him, yet such love cannot be bought at any price.

EchoChoiceMenu_FlavorText01.name: only others can give voice to her desires; but she, in turn, can lend them potency.

MedeaCurseMenu_FlavorText01.name: those who shunned or scorned her served only to inspire her more.
